query: Which statistical approaches (multi-group CFA, alignment optimization, item-response models) are most suitable to assess measurement invariance across languages and cultures for perceived usefulness and trust?

response.query: Which statistical approaches (multi-group CFA, alignment optimization, item-response models) are most suitable to assess measurement invariance across languages and cultures for perceived usefulness and trust?
response.answer: Multi-group CFA and alignment optimization are most suitable for assessing measurement invariance across languages and cultures for perceived usefulness and trust. Item-response models are also useful but less commonly employed for this purpose.
